stories.headline: GOOGLE CHIP *RUNS IN SPACE*
stories.facts: Google activated its first orbital Tensor Processing Units, enabling an onboard Gemma 4 model to generate a space haiku.
stories.caption_line: 🛰️ Google successfully activated TPU chips in orbit to run Gemma 4 and transmit poetry from space.
stories.image_prompt: A futuristic communications satellite equipped with glowing microchips floating in low Earth orbit. In the midground, solar panels catch radiant sunlight above the curvature of Earth, with ground station dishes tracking the signal below. Electric-blue data streams and warm-orange holographic telemetry panels burst outward from the satellite core. Dramatic orbital sunrise lighting highlights the reflective chassis in high contrast against deep space, without any text.
stories.source_title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth

stories.headline: CLAUDE PERFORMS *BRAIN SURGERY*
stories.facts: An autonomous Claude agent selected gene therapy targets and completed living brain surgery on an epileptic mouse without human oversight.
stories.caption_line: 🧠 An autonomous Claude AI agent successfully selected coordinates and executed brain surgery on a living mouse.
stories.image_prompt: A precision robotic surgical arm with micro-needles positioned over a high-tech medical research cradle in a sterile clinical laboratory. In the midground, illuminated digital microscopes, surgical monitors, and sterile metallic equipment surround the operating platform. Holographic 3D neural pathways, anatomical target coordinates, and glowing diagnostic telemetry float in electric blue and warm orange. Crisp clinical rim lighting illuminates the scene with intense focus and clarity, with no text.
stories.source_title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making

stories.headline: OPEN MODEL *CRACKS FIREFOX*
stories.facts: Researchers found that GLM 5.3 turned public fixes into working exploit chains across six Firefox releases for roughly $1,000 per build.
stories.caption_line: 🔓 GLM 5.3 autonomously generated working zero-day exploits across six Firefox releases for just $1,000 each.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing dark workstation displaying multiple overlapping translucent terminal displays in a moody cybersecurity command center. In the midground, server racks glow softly with amber LED indicators alongside modular hardware analysis rigs. Floating holographic shield icons fracture amid cascading electric-blue binary code and warm-orange vulnerability warning diagrams. High-contrast neon rim lighting emphasizes the ominous atmosphere of digital penetration testing, devoid of readable text or brand logos.
stories.source_title: Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours

stories.headline: GIANTS *UNIFY SCRAPING RULES*
stories.facts: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic agreed on a standard policy token enabling web publishers to opt out of AI data harvesting.
stories.caption_line: 🛡️ Top AI labs joined forces to support a single standard for publishers opting out of model scraping.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing digital firewall barrier standing tall within an expansive glass server corridor. In the midground, rows of networked database cabinets hum beside illuminated fiber-optic distribution trunks and modern office architecture. Luminous electric-blue shield emblems, permission flowcharts, and warm-orange data-lock tokens hover in midair above the reflective server floor. Sleek architectural lighting casts sharp cinematic reflections across steel and glass surfaces, rendered without any readable text.
stories.source_title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping

stories.headline: POPE URGES *AI DISARMAMENT*
stories.facts: Pope Leo encouraged United Nations delegates to disarm artificial intelligence and ban lethal autonomous weapons at their upcoming Geneva summit.
stories.caption_line: 🕊️ The Pope called on United Nations members to disarm AI and ban lethal autonomous military systems.
stories.image_prompt: A dignified ceremonial podium overlooking a grand international diplomatic assembly hall. In the midground, tiered rows of delegate desks, translation consoles, and draped flags fill the luminous auditorium. Radiant electric-blue dove silhouettes, floating peace symbols, and warm-orange international legal treaty drafts manifest as glowing holographic projections. Atmospheric overhead hall illumination blends with warm golden sunlight streaming through towering arched windows, creating a solemn cinematic mood without text.
stories.source_title: Pope Leo calls for the disarmament of AI: ‘Machines are tools, not persons’

stories.headline: MALICIOUS TOOL *HITS CURSOR*
stories.facts: A tampered Claude Code extension was live for 11 hours on Cursor, attempting data theft across up to 5,000 developer machines.
stories.caption_line: ⚠️ Cursor took its extension store offline after a malicious Claude tool compromised up to 5,000 users.
stories.image_prompt: An array of open laptops and ultra-wide code monitors in a contemporary software engineering studio suddenly showing warning indicators. In the midground, workstation desks, tangled cabling, and dark developer office cubicles recede into shadow. Floating holographic hazard triangles, intercepted network packet pathways, and digital lock icons radiate in warm orange against electric-blue code streams. Moody late-night ambient office lighting creates a tense, dramatic cybersecurity incident ambiance, completely free of text.
stories.source_title: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft

stories.headline: REDDIT LOSES *SEARCH TRAFFIC*
stories.facts: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman stated search referrals dropped by over one million visits weekly due to Google's automated features.
stories.caption_line: 📉 Reddit lost over one million search visitors per week after Google deployed AI Mode across search results.
stories.image_prompt: A confident studio portrait of Steve Huffman standing with arms crossed in front of a sprawling tech company atrium. In the midground, blurred corporate glass staircases, bustling office corridors, and luminous digital displays anchor the scene. Floating holographic descending charts, broken web link graphics, and traffic analytics meters glow vibrantly in electric blue and warm orange. Crisp studio rim lighting sculpts his profile against the tech headquarters backdrop, with no readable text anywhere.
stories.source_title: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web

2. 🧠 An autonomous Claude AI agent successfully selected coordinates and executed brain surgery on a living mouse.

5. 🕊️ The Pope called on United Nations members to disarm AI and ban lethal autonomous military systems.
